g.text: 31b · Pipeline failure handling, partial vector cleanup and DLQ routing
Multimodal processing error (e.g. model timeout or corrupt audio)
Execute rollback: Delete any partially written staging vectors
Update Reel index status to FAILED with error diagnostic code
Requeue message with exponential backoff delay
Publish message to Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) for operator inspection
Operator alerted; DLQ retains full payload and failure stack trace for debugging
